title: Divining Rods
notes: ~280 individual articles A-Z; very high KG value (each = concept node)

footnotes.text: Similar practices persist today among some who live in rural communities.

The earliest manuscript copy of the revelation now found inDoctrine and Covenants 8calls it a “sprout.” In 1833, when this revelation was prepared for publication, Sidney Rigdon revised the text to refer to a “rod of nature.”Revelation, April 1829–B [D&C 8],” in Revelation Book 1, 13, josephsmithpapers.org;Book of Commandments, 1833, 19, josephsmithpapers.org;Doctrine and Covenants, 1835, 161, josephsmithpapers.org.
